canonicalization.future_comparison_target: the sealed run_1 output artifact set, addressed by its inventory and artifact SHA256 values
publication_gate: pre/post snapshots prove each run used the same clean detached linked worktree, commit, RAW inventory, vendor bridge, config, executor environment, and generated command argv
method manifests agree with their execution snapshots, and run_1/run_2 use the same execution identity and command shape
all other differences are either normalized by the exact method-manifest JSON-pointer allowlist or reported as blockers
Run 1 and evidence are published to a new destination through atomic staging and exact retained-copy verification

retention.canonical_payload: retain the run_1 artifact set under stable ignored local_validation_artifacts storage
retention.tracked_pointer: retain a compact sanitized summary with hashes and regeneration metadata
retention.verification_evidence: retain four execution snapshots, both receipts, the pair comparison, and a verifier-backed summary; run_2 output is not a second baseline

canonicalization.stop_rule: If the publication gate fails, publish no baseline and diagnose nondeterminism instead of choosing either run.

GO: All Phase 2 parity and lineage gates pass.
The successor reduces ownership, dependency, or replay cost relative to the minimal strangler.
No required-exact artifact or unapproved public surface changes.
KILL: Two changed-hypothesis evidence loops still cannot achieve CSV, scan, or vendor-call parity.
The successor imports legacy output, diagnostics, or orchestration as a behavior owner.
A non-Thermo capability requires semantic fiction.
Change cost is not lower than the minimal strangler.
NARROW: Run identity, lineage, or delivery locators are valuable but acquisition or application replacement is not yet cheaper.
Retain only the independently proven substrate.

dimensions.comparison_rule: Successor forbidden crossings must be zero and total crossings must not increase.
Behavior and projection authority counts must decrease or remain one per responsibility.
Candidate must instrument both sides; unknown cannot be scored as an improvement and opens must not increase without approved expected diff.
Candidate must instrument both sides; calls must not increase without approved expected diff.
Candidate must instrument both sides; extracted points must not increase without an explained batching or fidelity tradeoff.
Compare representative repeated runs; do not claim improvement from a single timing sample.
Candidate must measure both sides; an unmeasured baseline remains unknown, not zero.
If a candidate adds a cache, include cold rebuild time and storage; warm-only timing cannot establish improvement.
Every analytical delivery cell must reach an immutable RAW ref and truthful evidence coordinate; required completion is 100 percent.
No public surface may change without a named disposition and expected-diff or migration contract.
Compare the tuple of production files, production lines, compatibility facades, persistent schemas, and migration steps; never collapse it into an unreviewable weighted score.
Backend-specific branches must decrease or be isolated behind truthful capabilities.

legacy_characterization_limits: This baseline freezes observed legacy behavior; it is not scientific truth.
The current targeted method manifest does not hash RAW or DLL directory contents and declares exact replay not ready.
The current targeted CLI does not expose RAW opens, vendor calls, extracted points, peak memory, or cache rebuild cost.
Existing raw_scan_indices are trace-array offsets, not vendor-native scan identifiers.
The in-repo CSV-to-workbook path is not proof of the external downstream analysis reader required by issue 130.
The default limited MS1-shape workflow is multi-stage (baseline, support generation, final); receipts must preserve those stages rather than flatten them.
The 2026-07-22 pair predates pre/post execution snapshots and the durable retained-copy verifier; it remains candidate evidence and is not the canonical comparison target.

scope.baseline: targeted CID-NL / NL116 current default path
